issue_request: FHIR-31701 was a Published/Persuasive R4B technical correction asking to change the sentence from "defines a set of capabilities use across the healthcare process" to grammatical wording, specifically marking the missing "d" in "used".

additional_context: FHIR-22752 was a separate Published/Persuasive correction for the same first sentence on the Modules page. Commit ba6c0f397d4671610cf62a336e1eae3f17b3a10a later changed the already-corrected phrase from "capabilities used" to "capabilities for use". The current source/modules.html is in the built page hierarchy as modules.html/Getting Started and reads "defines a set of capabilities for use across the healthcare process".
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current wording has no "capabilities use" typo, and reverting it to FHIR-31701's exact "used" wording would undo a later accepted correction for the same sentence.
